description:
See 30+ of the best London sightseeing spots on the ultimate London walking tour!

On this exciting London walking tour you'll start in the City of London and explore 2000 years of history with famous London sights including:

Tower of London, St Paul's Cathedral, Tower Bridge, Bank of England, Monument, Leadenhall Market, Royal Exchange, London Bridge, The Shard, City Hall & more.

After a quick lunch stop (own expense) you’ll then take a journey on the famous London Underground to visit Westminster and see even more of the best London sightseeing spots including:

Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square, Houses of Parliament, London Eye, Downing Street, St James’s Palace, Clarence House, The Mall & more.

Led by a local London tour guide, the tour uses photos to bring the stories of London to life in a relaxed atmosphere (no boring lectures!) allowing everyone to participate in the tour with questions, trivia, great photo opportunities and a lot of fun!

---------

Max. 18 per tour

---------

IMPORTANT: Please note this tour uses the London Underground. A valid Oyster Card, Contactless Credit/Debit Card, Apple Pay or Travelcard is required for each customer.
hostdescription:
Hi, I'm Mike :)

Born and raised in London, I've also previously lived in Australia and have worked in the tourism industry leading group tours for the past 8 years.

Currently, I work for a tour company in London called See The Sights Tours which offers many London walking tours (look us up!) where I get to indulge in my passion for London's history, culture and landmarks.

London is a fantastic city with so many incredible places to visit and I would love to share the magic and secrets of the city with you.
locationDescription: London is a magical city with so much to see and we'll cover all the Top Sightseeing Spots. Starting at St Paul's Station (Exit 2) we'll cover all the main sights of London including Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square, Tower of London, Westminster Abbey, St Paul's Cathedral, Houses of Parliament, Tower Bridge, Monument, Downing Street and so many more!
